firm_data.firm_description: Certain & Zilberg, PLLC is an award winning products liability and personal injury law firm with decades of trial experience and an earned reputation for obtaining some of the largest verdicts awarded in New York. Our firm known for its tireless work ethic, medical and technical knowledge, creativity, integrity and tenacious determination to obtain maximum results.
notable_facts: Cases have been covered by major news outlets across the country.
Actively involved in advocating for the rights of injury victims, product safety, civil liberties and policing reforms.
Accepts referrals from attorneys across the country and offer trial counsel, local and co-counsel services.

email.subject: AI for Certain & Zilberg, PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

Your cases have been covered by major news outlets across the country, and that kind of visibility comes from winning trials and delivering results. I imagine managing the technical complexity and volume that comes with high-profile products liability work is a different challenge entirely.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters for trial practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
